revisions.name: $th_sse_rm
revisions.reason: Reached SSE2 gear-builder arithmetic/conversions use existing per-thread XMM and width-specific memory paths. CVTPD2PS m128 extends existing CVTDQ2PS alignment rejection before destination write; same decoded block-offset fault EIP and existing SEH return. No new callback/frame/state lifetime; general invocation ownership stays pending.
